systems.owner: MECC (education ministry), developed with the World Bank
systems.tiers: schools send data; to link the central level and the districts

systems.country_label: plataforma nacional de aprendizagem digital (passaporte para a aprendizagem)

note: No fact: the compact (June 2023; capture truncated at the fetch limit) describes the SIGE only as a collection of education data that schools send to a deadline, beside the annual statistical bulletin, and nowhere says schools add per-learner records, so it is classed census here. What it states, for the parent: many schools are not using the SIGE for want of electricity, computers or internet or because it is hard to use, so data arrive late; disaggregated data on learners with disabilities and out-of-school children are not yet collected; the ministry and the World Bank are developing the EMIS/SIGE to link the central level and the districts; improving the SIGE is a listed action. No count or share of schools is given.
